JOYSTAR Aquaboy Kids Cruiser Bike - Sizes 12" to 16"
Cruise the neighborhood in classic style with the JOYSTAR Aquaboy Kids Cruiser Bike. Inspired by vintage beach cruisers, this bike is engineered to provide young riders aged 2-7 with a smooth, comfortable, and safe introduction to cycling.

Classic beach cruiser aesthetics meet modern kid-friendly safety.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Built for durability and ease of use, the Aquaboy combines a impact-resistant frame with intuitive braking systems for young explorers."
Superior Safety Systems
Safety is the foundation of the Aquaboy design. The high-tensile HI-TEN steel frame and fork offer exceptional impact resistance on rocky or bumpy terrain. To ensure total control, the bike features a reliable rear coaster brake, allowing kids to stop simply by pedaling backward—a natural movement for young learners.

A fully enclosed chain guard keeps small fingers safe and clothes clean.

Key Features & Benefits

Growth-Ready: Features an adjustable comfort saddle and stem height to ensure a perfect fit as your child grows.

Easy Pedaling: Low gearing and sealed bearings make the drivetrain smooth and effortless for small legs.

Enhanced Comfort: Equipped with a dual-spring cruiser seat for a cushioned ride on any pavement.

Classic Style: Stylish front and rear fenders, painted rims, and a vintage bike bell complete the cruiser look.

Quick & Easy Assembly
The JOYSTAR Aquaboy comes 85% pre-assembled. With the included tools and simple instructions, your child can be ready to ride in just a few easy steps.

Simple Setup: Follow our guide to get the Aquaboy road-ready in roughly 20 minutes.

Size Chart & Fit Guide

See It In Action

Smooth riding: See how the Aquaboy handles the sidewalk with ease.

Included Extras: Front/Rear Fenders, Heavy-Duty Training Wheels, Bike Bell, DIY Decal Stickers

Our Guarantee
JOYSTAR stands behind every bike we build, ensuring your family has a worry-free riding experience:

Lifetime Warranty: The steel frame is covered for as long as the original purchaser owns the bike.

Quality Components: Durable parts designed to withstand the rigors of childhood play.
